import json,time,subprocess,sys,resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from main import transport

def check(r,label):
 raw=json.dumps(r,separators=(',',':')).encode()
 print(label,'bytes',len(raw),flush=True)
 st=time.monotonic()
 p=subprocess.run(['python3','-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=raw,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
 elapsed=time.monotonic()-st
 print(label,'elapsed',round(elapsed,3),'status',p.returncode,'out bytes',len(p.stdout),'err',p.stderr[:1000],flush=True)
 assert p.returncode==0
 out=json.loads(p.stdout);assert 'sessions' in out,out
 return out
